title: Protocol for Standard RNA Synthesis with Hi-T7 RNA Polymerase
author: New England Biolabs
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8tnhwme

steps.title: Prepare Kit Components
steps.instruction: Thaw the necessary kit components, mix, and pulse-spin in a microfuge to collect solutions at the bottom of the tubes.

steps.title: Assemble RNA Synthesis Reaction
steps.instruction: Assemble the reaction at room temperature in a total volume of 20 µL by adding the following components in order:

substeps.instruction: Add X µl Nuclease-free Water (New England Biolabs Catalog #E6317)
Add 2 µL 10X Hi-T7 RNA Polymerase Reaction Buffer (New England Biolabs Catalog #M0658S)
Add X µl of each NTP at 0.5 millimolar (mM)
Add X µl of Template DNA (between 0.2 µg to 1 µg)
Add 0.5 µL RNase Inhibitor (1 U/µl final)
Add 2 µL Hi-T7 RNA Polymerase (50 U/ml, New England Biolabs Catalog #M0658S)

steps.title: Incubate Reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction mixture at 50 °C for 1 hour (01:00:00).
